type.provenance: This act would prohibit the sale or promotional distribution of any food package in Rhode Island which contains perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), effective January 1, 2024.

who.provenance: No package or packaging component shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state

action.provenance: prohibited from selling or offering for sale food packages containing PFAS

products.provenance: which contains perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

exceptions.provenance: No exceptions are mentioned for the ban on PFAS in food packaging

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The text explicitly bans PFAS, implying it's not currently unavoidable

intentionally_added.provenance: The ban applies to PFAS 'intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution'
